name: Database Migration Baseline
description: Captures business context, constraints and technical drivers needed to plan a database migration.

sections.title: Business Context
sections.description: Understand the business drivers and stakeholders behind this migration.

questions.text: What is the primary business driver for this migration?
Who is the primary business owner / sponsor?
Describe the scope of this engagement in your own words.
What is the maximum tolerable downtime during cutover? (hours)
What is the Recovery Time Objective (RTO)?
What is the Recovery Point Objective (RPO)?
Are there blackout periods when migration is not permitted?
If yes, describe the blackout periods (e.g. month-end, seasonal peaks).
Which compliance frameworks apply?
Is data residency / sovereignty a requirement?
Are there restrictions on data leaving the current environment?
Describe any specific security or audit requirements.
What is the preferred target platform?
Is the target platform already provisioned?
Is a hybrid / phased migration acceptable?
Are there preferred Azure regions?
Are there applications tightly coupled to the database that must be migrated together?
List known application or integration dependencies.
Are there database-specific features in use that may not be supported on the target?
questions.helpText: e.g. Oracle RAC, linked servers, CLR assemblies, specific collations

questions.text: Is there an existing DBA team who will support the migration?
